title: MaaD-TAD: Molecular all-atom Display of TADs (code for the PRAMEF/HNRNPCL all-atom model)
description: MaaD-TAD is a Python pipeline that turns a 3D path of a chromatin domain into an all-atom model of DNA and histones. Its four modules, Folder, Placer, Builder and Checker, refold the path, place the nucleosomes, build and close every linker in atoms, and check and repair the model. This release is the code (S1 File) of the paper 'MaaD-TAD: an all-atom model of the duplicated PRAMEF/HNRNPCL chromatin domain built from sequence homology', with the inputs and the scripts that regenerate its figures. The full-atom model and the larger data files are in a separate Zenodo data record.
